lessons_used: Reordering sign-in after pet or companion selection, live generation countdown timers, personality headlines, path duration hints, and account safety or persistence hints worked to improve performance.
Major redesigns, sub-flows, trait selectors, story or quality guidance copy, estimated time headlines, and reordering sign-in after photo upload hurt performance.
Flow bypasses and tutorial screens yielded mixed results, winning in early tests but hurting or showing no effect in later ones.
Notifications and alerts, layout modifications, incentives, permission checks, and wait screen activity tips showed no clear effect.
Predictions overestimated gains for major redesigns, sub-flows, copy overhauls, and reordering sign-in after photo upload.
Predictions underestimated gains for account safety and persistence hints, path duration hints, personality headlines, and wait countdown timers.

candidates.title: Previous Pet Restore Reassurance Hint
candidates.change: Adds an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that existing pets and saved items are automatically restored upon signing in.
candidates.why: Support mailbox received 8 complaints about pets missing or resetting after signing in again, and previous test lessons show account persistence hints strongly improve performance.

sign_in.hint: Signing in automatically restores your existing pets, custom progress, and saved items.

guard.reason: Adds a valid reassurance hint on the sign-in screen without violating any rules.

candidates.score_note: Account persistence hints strongly perform and address top support complaints.

candidates.title: Generation Safety Countdown and Restore Indicator
candidates.change: Displays live progress and cloud backup status alongside the generation countdown on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home dropoff occurs while waiting (median 201s, mean 2336s). Past lessons showed countdown timers and cloud sync indicators reduce drop-off during long wait times.

waiting.hint: Your pet is being generated and saved securely to your account cloud.

guard.reason: Displays progress and time estimates on the waiting screen during actual generation, which is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Live wait screen countdowns consistently recover drop-offs during long wait times.

candidates.title: Path Selection Personality Card Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the path selection screen with structured cards focusing on companion personality traits and journey duration.
candidates.why: Choose path has a high mean duration (514s) and past lessons indicate personality headlines and duration hints positively impact user progression.

path_options.text: Select your companion personality and journey speed

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop Placement Launch Verification Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated confirmation screen right before completing onboarding to verify desktop readiness and launch status.
candidates.why: Finish step drops off at 71.6% (mean 5815s) and support received 3 tickets reporting pets not appearing on desktop or app failing to launch.

new_launch_verify.headline: Pet Ready for Your Desktop
new_launch_verify.body: Your pet is active on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Adds a new verification screen after home_intro while retaining all required onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding a full new verification screen has high cost and modest historical returns.

candidates.title: Sign-In Account Sync Card Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the sign-in interface into clean option cards highlighting quick sign-in and cloud pet recovery.
candidates.why: Sign-in step dropoff is 86.2% and 8 support tickets report missing pets after sign-in. Rebuilding layout around account safety addresses both drop-off and support issues.

sign_in_options.text: Sign in to backup your pet and restore existing companions

guard.reason: replacement for 'sign_in.sign_in_options' does not do the job (a sign-in button that says so): needs 1 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Starter Companion Fast-Track Hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint on the path choice screen highlighting expected setup completion time under 1 minute.
candidates.why: Choose_path has a median duration of 8s but a long mean of 514s; past lessons confirm duration hints effectively guide users forward.

choose_path.hint: Fast-track companion setup takes under 1 minute and automatically backs up your progress.

guard.reason: Adds setup guidance text on the path choice screen without removing steps or jobs.

candidates.score_note: Path duration hints consistently outperform expectations with low implementation effort.

candidates.title: Customization Safety and Format Guidance Copy
candidates.change: Updates headline and body copy on the photo upload screen to provide clear photo quality guidelines for pet creation.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops off to 69.3% and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failing or looking incorrect.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Pet Photo for Custom Companion
upload_photos.body: Use clear, well-lit photos for the best companion rendering results.

guard.reason: Updates photo upload guidance copy appropriately within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Quality guidance copy overhaul historically hurt conversion on the adoption step.

candidates.title: Preset Adoption Companion Selection Flow
candidates.change: Introduces a grid layout flow for selecting instant pet presets to prevent generation issues and speed up customization.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low (69.3%) with long wait times (1017s mean), and preset selection bypasses rendering failure points.

pick_friend.hint: Choose from instant starter pets or build a custom companion.

guard.reason: Updates the pet selection screen layout while maintaining its core selection job.

candidates.score_note: Sub-flows and major flow redesigns consistently underperform and carry high dev cost.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Ready Alert Notification
candidates.change: Enables desktop readiness alert notifications when pet generation completes on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s; notifying users when their pet is ready prevents drop-off during background generation.

waiting.hint: We will alert you on your desktop as soon as your companion is ready.

guard.reason: Enables desktop readiness notifications on the waiting screen within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Notifications show neutral to mild positive impact on wait screen drop-off.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Visibility Control Hint
candidates.change: Adds a persistent guidance hint on the home intro screen detailing tray icon controls to show, hide, or talk to the pet.
candidates.why: Support mailbox received 3 emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or interact with their pet after setup.

home_intro.hint: Click the desktop tray icon anytime to hide, show, or control your companion.

guard.reason: Adds helpful control guidance text to the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Simple control hints reduce end-of-funnel confusion with quick configuration updates.

picked: Generation Safety Countdown and Restore Indicator

decisions.title: Generation Safety Countdown and Restore Indicator

lessons_next: Account safety/persistence hints, path duration hints, personality headlines, and live generation countdown timers consistently improved performance.
Reordering sign-in after pet or companion selection improved performance, whereas reordering sign-in after photo upload hurt performance.
Major redesigns, sub-flows, trait selectors, story copy, quality guidance, and estimated time headlines either hurt performance or showed no clear effect.
Flow bypasses and tutorial screens yielded mixed results, winning in early rounds but hurting or showing no clear effect in later rounds.
Notifications and alerts, layout modifications, incentives, permission checks, and wait screen activity tips showed no clear effect.
Predictions overestimated gains for major redesigns, sub-flows, copy overhauls, and sign-in reordering after photo upload, while underestimating gains for hints, headlines, and countdown timers.
